applies_why: No; the judge's UNDERDETERMINED reason is the defender's dropped curse limb leaving no live link, not a single verse's failure to state a link or its contrary.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: "single verse does not state a link or its contrary" versus "no live link remains to contradict": one reading forbids any use of a verse's silence to support UNDERDETERMINED, while the other forbids only express reliance on that silence; the judge's stated ground is the dropped-limb/no-live-link point, not verse silence.
why: The judge did not base UNDERDETERMINED on Jeremiah 22:30 failing to state a link or its contrary; it based it on C4 pressing a curse limb the defender had dropped, leaving no live link to contradict.
